newsitem.title: USA: NY physical coffee - roasters snub wild futures.
newsitem.headline: NY physical coffee - roasters snub wild futures.

text.p: Business was sporadic on the New York physical coffee market this week, as surging futures prices and pricey spot premiums kept roasters pinned to the sidelines, dealers said.
Prompt sales were seen only on a fill-in basis only, with roasters nearby needs fairly well met, they added.
"Roasters are covered for January, February and March," one trader said. "No nearby coffee is trading anywhere."
But continued hand-to-mouth buying by roasters, coupled with low stock levels, are likely to keep differentials and future prices buoyant, traders said.
Roaster may be forced to hike retail prices soon if the recent uptrend in the futures market continues, traders said. Since the beginning of the year, prices have jumped by nearly 30 percent.
But, they added, roasters were likely to wait for futures volatility to subside.
"The roasters will wait for the market to stabilize and quiet down before they announce a price increase," one trader said.
Traders saw little relief for roasters, as news Colombia's output in January came in well below last year's levels is likely to keep Colombian differentials sky-high.
